name: session-mods
description: Two session mods: a calm side pane (first prompt, sub-agents with their history, the session's reasoning steps) and a bar beneath the prompt (running time, prompt-cache countdown, context usage, quotas, and the model and effort selectors)

panel.title: Session pane
panel.description: Open the session pane (/session-panel) and record what it shows. Off, only the bar beneath the prompt runs: no pane, no /session-panel, no session_title tool. On by default.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: The prompt-cache lifetime to count down from (a model switch reports the real one)

situation.title: Situation section
situation.description: Show the Situation section on Main: the live state of the session's topic, read from notes in ~/Notes/claude, factory's log, the terminal session's tabs and GitHub. Off by default.

rename.title: Rename the session
rename.description: Name the session (/resume, the terminal tab) with the pane's title, and give the agent the session_title tool and its first-prompt reminder. Off, the title only heads the pane, so another tool can own the session's name. On by default.
